title: vote.stage
description: server → host and clients. The round entered a stage. The server is the only clock for vote stages. CLOSED ends the round: after it the host may open the next vote.

startedAtMs.description: Server clock when the stage began.

endsAtMs.description: Server clock when the stage ends; null for untimed stages (solo VOTE, CLOSED). A stage can end earlier (early close, Decision Time, host close, trivia answered).

candidateIds.description: Options that can be chosen in this stage: all winnable options (VOTE), the two runoff options (RUNOFF), the tied options (TIEBREAK_TRIVIA, TIEBREAK_PICK). For REVEAL, PREDICT, INSPECT, RESULT and CLOSED: all options not vetoed.

pickerId.description: TIEBREAK_PICK only: the trivia winner who must send `vote.trivia.pick`; null otherwise.

OptionId.description: Identifier of one option inside a vote round. For PART votes it equals the part id; for CONTRACT votes the contract id; for PILOT votes a PlayerId; for quick votes an upper-case token defined in the vote-kind table (e.g. TEST, SKIP).

PlayerId.description: Player identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "p" followed by a positive integer (p1, p2, …).

RoundId.description: Vote round identifier chosen by the host; unique within the room for its whole lifetime.

TimeMs.description: Absolute time on the server clock: integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Every `…AtMs` field in the protocol uses the server clock (see Clock).
